test_item_verbatim: When “More Aux” button is pressed a popup opens up with all available aux cameras as selectable buttons

tcs.tc_title: the More Aux button opens a popup listing all available AUX cameras
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. Two wired AUX cameras are connected
4. The rear view camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "More Aux" button in the rear view camera image
2. Read the pop-up and check that both connected AUX cameras are offered as selectable buttons
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "More Aux" button registers the press and a pop-up opens
2. Both connected AUX cameras are shown in the pop-up as selectable buttons
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: the More Aux button opens a popup listing all available AUX cameras
tcs.test_item:
When “More Aux” button is pressed a popup opens up with all available aux cameras as selectable buttons

(the More Aux button opens a popup listing all available AUX cameras)

reasoning: §27.8 之父題逐字為 `Accessing Aux Cameras – from Rear View Camera`（`NRL-188082`），故前提取 `Rear_View_Camera = 1` 與「後視影像顯示中」。`all available aux cameras` 之 `all` 須以**兩台**以上才驗得，故前提佈兩台。`“More Aux”` 為逐字按鍵名（§28.1 另有 `More Cams Button`，屬 `Camera View Switching` 組，非本列）。
